note: Stage 3 (2026-10-18, [У]): split by the audit of the new statements q72-q103 (local/research/statement_audit_new/). Same method as stage 2: applied after stage 2, parts keep the parent's orientation and sign, Jev only chooses the part.

209a.plus_en: Lengthens or allows longer working time (longer week, longer shifts).
209a.minus_en: Shortens working time by law (shorter week, caps on shifts, e.g. for medical interns).

209b.plus_en: Lets parents work more, part-time or flexibly (e.g. part-time work while on maternity pay, flexible arrangements).
209b.minus_en: Restricts such flexible or part-time work for parents.

301a.plus_en: Increases state funding of charities and non-profits or tax incentives for donations.

301b.plus_en: Leaves donations from foreign governments to non-profits untaxed and unrestricted.
301b.minus_en: Taxes, restricts or penalises donations from foreign governments to non-profits.

186a.name_en: Torah study as an alternative to military service
186a.plus_en: Recognises full-time Torah study as service or as grounds for exemption.

186b.name_ru: гражданская служба и отказ по убеждениям
186b.plus_en: Widens civilian or national service and exemption on grounds of conscience as alternatives to the army.

250a.plus_en: Makes gun licences harder to get or keep.
250a.minus_en: Makes gun licences easier to get (e.g. for former combat soldiers).

250b.plus_en: Toughens penalties and enforcement against illegal weapons and arms trading.

103b1.name_ru: иммунитет солдат и полиции за действия на службе
103b1.name_en: Immunity of soldiers and police for operational actions
103b1.plus_en: Grants or widens immunity of soldiers or police for actions during operations, or requires special approval to investigate them.

103b2.name_en: Powers of security agencies over civilians
103b2.plus_en: Gives police, prison and security services wider powers over civilians (searches, access to personal data, secret information).

12a.name_en: Ban on conversion therapy for minors
12a.plus_en: Bans or restricts therapy aimed at changing a minor's sexual orientation.

12b.plus_en: Health funds and providers owe patients more services and rights (treatment times, refunds, coverage).

12c.plus_en: Lets patients and visitors bring any food into hospitals during Passover.
12c.minus_en: Restricts bringing leavened food into hospitals during Passover.

100a.name_ru: камеры в учреждениях для детей и уязвимых
100a.name_en: Cameras to protect children and vulnerable people in care
100a.plus_en: Requires or extends cameras in daycare centres, kindergartens, special education or care institutions, or access to their footage.

100b.plus_en: Requires police to film the use of water cannons and other crowd-control means.

100c.name_en: Broadcasting court hearings and public meetings
100c.plus_en: Requires filming or broadcasting of court hearings, council meetings or other public proceedings.

271a.plus_en: Keeps or adds restrictions on cannabis.
271a.minus_en: Legalises or decriminalises cannabis for personal or medical use.

271b.plus_en: Keeps or adds restrictions on selling alcohol.
271b.minus_en: Allows wider sale of alcohol (e.g. wine in large stores).

253a.plus_en: Expands free public educational services, from early childhood to after-school programmes and higher education.

253b.plus_en: Creates or expands a Haredi stream within state education.

124a.plus_en: Lets a prime minister serve longer or removes limits.
124a.minus_en: Limits how long a person may serve as prime minister.

124b.plus_en: Lets justices serve longer (until retirement age).
124b.minus_en: Fixes a maximum number of years for justices.
